title: Ya Hussain
body:
Jo Nabi Ke Ishq Ka Daawedar Hai
Kya Usey Karbala Ka Zulm Yaad Hai
Kya Use Ali Akbar Ka Gham Satata Hai
Kya Usse Ali Asghar Ka Naam Rulata Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad Aaj Bhi Woh Rona, Woh Pyaas Hai
Andaaz-E-Ghaazi, Mashk Jin Ke Paas Hai
Duain Leke Zainab Kulsum Ki
Alamdaar Un Ka Bhai, Abbaas Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Zulfiqar Ka Andaaz Hai
Insaaf Ki Unchi Awaaz Hai
Nabi Ke Deen Ko Bachaya Hai
Aaj Phir Se Islam Ka Aghaaz Hai
